subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should installed hooks require a regular `HOOK.md` file no larger than 1 MiB?
rationale: The implementation correctly fixes the memory-exhaustion path, but the chosen helper deliberately narrows accepted package inputs beyond only adding a byte cap.

options.title: Accept the bounded contract
options.body: Approve the 1 MiB regular-file requirement and merge after exact-head gates complete.

options.title: Adjust accepted inputs
options.body: Choose a different size or symlink policy and add matching contract and real-path coverage before merge.
